ja426:1.1: yāpanīyaṃ kacci mātula te sukhaṃ, sukhaṃ te ammā avaca, sukhakāmā hi te mayan ti.
ja426:2.1: Naṅguṭṭham me avakkamma heṭhayitvāna eḷiki s' ajja mātulavādena muñcitabbā nu maññasīti.
ja426:3.1: Puratthāmukho nisinno si, ahaṃ te mukham āgatā, pacchato tuyha naṅguṭṭhaṃ, kathaṃ kho 'haṃ avakkamin ti.
ja426:4.1: Yāvatā caturo dīpā sasamuddā sapabbatā tāvatā mayha naṅguṭṭhaṃ kathaṃ kho tvaṃ vivajjayīti.
ja426:5.1: Pubbe va m' etaṃ akkhaṃsu mātā pitā ca bhātaro: dīghaṃ duṭṭhassa naṅguṭṭhaṃ, s' amhi vehāyasāgatā ti.
ja426:6.1: Tañca disvāna āyantiṃ antalikkhasmim eḷiki migasaṃgho palāyittha, bhakkho me nāsito tayā
ja426:7.1: ti. Icc-eva vilapantiyā eḷikiyā ruhaṃghaso galakaṃ anvāmaddi n' atthi duṭṭhe subhāsitaṃ.
ja426:8.1: N' eva duṭṭhe nayo atthi na dhammo na subhāsitaṃ, nikkamaṃ duṭṭhe yujjetha, so ca sabbhi na rajjatīti
